g.text: Four single episodes under the new simhealth contract
A0 task-window metrics are valid; its controller exited1. No whole-project GO or RF/algorithm superiority claim.
GT is offline diagnostic only, never Policy input. Open circles=start; squares=last in-phase sample. No padded curve/trajectory endpoints.
A0/B02: aae; A1-03: 2be; C: bd663. Poststop/report/observation deltas disclosed. Different paths and input availability; one episode per arm.
